page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.xlarge is a virtual server instance within the shared ecs.s6 family, virtualized on a KVM hypervisor. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and operates using an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 shared vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, presenting a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The server contains no integrated local storage and no dedicated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs. External network-attached block devices are necessary for persistent storage operations. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance by default.

Due to its shared CPU allocation model, CPU execution cycles are distributed among multiple tenants, which provides economic efficiency for lower-utilization tasks but introduces variability under persistent peak compute loads. The ecs.s6-c1m4.xlarge is structurally suited for lightweight enterprise applications, staging and test environments, small database instances, and general-purpose web serving.
